guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: recommendationservice has the largest latency shifts (latency-50 z=+773, latency-90 z=+700) together with socket count rising from 4 to 21.4 (z=+87) and memory about 3x, while its workload fell 77%, and frontend warnings 'failed to get product recommendations' show callers failing on it. The frontend errors and latency are downstream effects; memory growth is plausibly a side effect of piled-up connections, and the checkout trace errors are not explained by this and remain unattributed.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the recommendationservice pods to clear leaked or stuck sockets, then inspect its connection handling and timeouts to PRODUCTCATALOGservice and its clients. Add connection limits and timeouts.
